name: Tonganosaurus
sum: Tonganosaurus is a mamenchisaurid sauropod from the Yimen Formation of Sichuan, China, similar to Omeisaurus and known from one partial skeleton.
wsnote: A size estimate exists in the Wikipedia revision but the figure was cut in the text read.
holotype: An incomplete adult skeleton with twenty vertebrae, a forelimb and pectoral girdle, and a complete hindlimb with a partial hip.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Li et al. 2010

sources.text: Li, Kui 2010. A new sauropod dinosaur from the Lower Jurassic of Huili, Sichuan, China. Vertebrata PalAsiatica 48(3): 185–202.

dates_note: The horizon of the specimen and the age of the Yimen Formation are controversial (Wikipedia revision); PBDB gives Hettangian-Toarcian.
